AWBuildVersion.why: One row of database build metadata (version and date); nothing points at it or from it and it describes no business thing.

Address.why: One row per postal address keyed by AddressID, pointing at StateProvince; BusinessEntityAddress and SalesOrderHeader point at it.

AddressType.why: Six address-type names keyed by AddressTypeID, pointed at only by BusinessEntityAddress.

BillOfMaterials.why: Which components, in what quantity, make each assembly, from StartDate to EndDate: the product structure in effect over time.

BusinessEntity.why: The supertype of people, stores and vendors, one row per BusinessEntityID; Person, Store, Vendor and the address and contact links point at it.

BusinessEntityAddress.why: Links business entities to addresses with an address type on the link, keyed by the three pointers.

BusinessEntityContact.why: Links business entities to contact people with a contact type on the link, keyed by the three pointers.

ContactType.why: 20 contact-type names keyed by ContactTypeID, pointed at only by BusinessEntityContact.

CountryRegion.why: 238 country names keyed by CountryRegionCode; CountryRegionCurrency, SalesTerritory and StateProvince point at it, so it stays unfolded.

CountryRegionCurrency.why: Pure link of CountryRegionCode and CurrencyCode, keyed by the pair.

CreditCard.why: One row per card keyed by CreditCardID with type, number and expiry; PersonCreditCard and SalesOrderHeader point at it.

Culture.why: Eight culture (language) names keyed by CultureID, pointed at only by ProductModelProductDescriptionCulture.

Currency.why: 105 currency names keyed by CurrencyCode; CountryRegionCurrency and CurrencyRate point at it, so it stays unfolded.

CurrencyRate.why: Daily exchange rates from USD to 14 currencies, one row per currency per CurrencyRateDate; the state of each rate as of a date, which SalesOrderHeader points at.

Customer.why: One row per customer keyed by CustomerID, pointing at Person, Store and SalesTerritory; SalesOrderHeader points at it.

DatabaseLog.why: One row per DDL statement run against the database, stamped with PostTime; a log of occurrences, though it points at no table.

Department.why: 16 department names with a group name, keyed by DepartmentID, pointed at only by EmployeeDepartmentHistory.

Document.why: 13 documents and folders keyed by DocumentNode with title, file name, revision and content, pointing at Employee as owner; ProductDocument points at it.

EmailAddress.why: One email address per person keyed by EmailAddressID, pointing at Person one-to-one; a contact attribute of Person.

Employee.why: One row per employee keyed by BusinessEntityID (one-to-one with Person) with job title and birth and hire dates (business dates); many tables point at it.

EmployeeDepartmentHistory.why: Which department and shift each employee was in, from StartDate to EndDate: the employee's state over time, not an occurrence.

EmployeePayHistory.why: Each employee's pay rate as of RateChangeDate, keyed by employee plus date: the rate in effect over time.

ErrorLog.why: Empty: declared as a log of database errors stamped with ErrorTime, but there are no rows to place it from.

Illustration.why: Five product-model drawings keyed by IllustrationID holding the diagram itself; content, not a label, which ProductModelIllustration points at.

JobCandidate.why: 13 job candidates keyed by JobCandidateID with a resume, two of them pointing at Employee.

Location.why: 14 manufacturing locations keyed by LocationID with a cost rate and availability, amounts that describe the place; ProductInventory and WorkOrderRouting point at it.

Password.why: One password hash and salt per person keyed by BusinessEntityID, a one-to-one extension of Person.

Person.why: One row per person keyed by BusinessEntityID with names and contact preferences; Employee, Customer, EmailAddress, PersonPhone and others point at it.

PersonCreditCard.why: Pure link of BusinessEntityID and CreditCardID, keyed by the pair.

PersonPhone.why: One phone number per person, keyed by BusinessEntityID, number and type, pointing at Person and PhoneNumberType; a contact attribute of Person.

PhoneNumberType.why: Three phone-type names (cell, home, work) keyed by PhoneNumberTypeID, pointed at only by PersonPhone.

Product.why: One row per product keyed by ProductID, pointing at ProductSubcategory, ProductModel and UnitMeasure; most of the production and sales tables point at it.

ProductCategory.why: Four category names keyed by ProductCategoryID, pointed at only by ProductSubcategory.

ProductCostHistory.why: Each product's standard cost as of StartDate, keyed by ProductID plus StartDate; three dates across 395 rows.

ProductDescription.why: 762 description texts keyed by ProductDescriptionID with nothing else, pointed at only by ProductModelProductDescriptionCulture, which pairs each with a model and culture.

ProductDocument.why: Pure link of ProductID and DocumentNode, keyed by the pair.

ProductInventory.why: Stock of each product at each location (ProductID and LocationID pointers, keyed by the pair) with shelf, bin and quantity on the link; no non-audit time.

ProductListPriceHistory.why: Each product's list price as of StartDate, keyed by ProductID plus StartDate; three dates across 395 rows.

ProductModel.why: One row per product model keyed by ProductModelID with catalogue text and instructions; Product and the model link tables point at it.

ProductModelIllustration.why: Pure link of ProductModelID and IllustrationID, keyed by the pair.

ProductModelProductDescriptionCulture.why: Links product models, descriptions and cultures, keyed by the three pointers and nothing else.

ProductPhoto.why: 101 product photos keyed by ProductPhotoID with thumbnail and large images and file names; content, which ProductProductPhoto points at.

ProductProductPhoto.why: Link of ProductID and ProductPhotoID, keyed by the pair, with a primary flag on the link.

ProductReview.why: One row per customer review of a product, stamped with ReviewDate, pointing at Product.

ProductSubcategory.why: 37 subcategory names keyed by ProductSubcategoryID with a pointer to their category, pointed at only by Product; a level of the product label hierarchy.

ProductVendor.why: Which vendors supply which products (ProductID and BusinessEntityID, keyed by the pair) with lead time, prices and order limits on the link; LastReceiptDate is a summary of the link, not the time of an occurrence.

PurchaseOrderDetail.why: Lines of a purchase order pointing at PurchaseOrderHeader and Product with quantities and price; a line item, so an event whose time sits on its header (it also carries DueDate).

PurchaseOrderHeader.why: One row per purchase order, stamped with OrderDate, pointing at Vendor, Employee and ShipMethod.

SalesOrderDetail.why: Lines of a sales order pointing at SalesOrderHeader and the product's special offer with quantity and price; a line item, so an event whose time sits on its header.

SalesOrderHeader.why: One row per sales order, stamped with OrderDate; CustomerID repeats across orders, and it also points at territory, addresses, card and ship method.

SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason.why: Pure link of SalesOrderID and SalesReasonID, keyed by the pair.

SalesPerson.why: 17 salespeople keyed by BusinessEntityID (one-to-one with Employee) with quota, bonus and year-to-date sales; orders, stores and quota history point at it.

SalesPersonQuotaHistory.why: Each salesperson's quota for a quarter, keyed by BusinessEntityID plus QuotaDate; 12 quarter dates across 163 rows.

SalesReason.why: Ten sales-reason names with a reason type, keyed by SalesReasonID, pointed at only by SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason.

SalesTaxRate.why: 29 tax rates keyed by SalesTaxRateID, pointing at StateProvince with a tax type, rate and name; the rate is an amount, so not a pure label.

SalesTerritory.why: Ten sales territories keyed by TerritoryID with country, group and sales figures; Customer, SalesOrderHeader, SalesPerson and StateProvince point at it.

SalesTerritoryHistory.why: Which territory each salesperson covered, from StartDate to EndDate: the salesperson's state over time.

ScrapReason.why: 16 scrap-reason names keyed by ScrapReasonID, pointed at only by WorkOrder.

Shift.why: Three work shifts keyed by ShiftID with a name and start and end times, times that describe the shift; EmployeeDepartmentHistory points at it.

ShipMethod.why: Five shipping methods keyed by ShipMethodID with base and per-unit rates, amounts that describe the method; both order headers point at it.

ShoppingCartItem.why: Three items placed in online carts, pointing at Product with a quantity and DateCreated; the item is an occurrence like an order line.

SpecialOffer.why: 16 offers keyed by SpecialOfferID with discount, type, date range and quantity limits; SpecialOfferProduct points at it.

SpecialOfferProduct.why: Pure link of SpecialOfferID and ProductID, keyed by the pair; SalesOrderDetail points at the pair.

StateProvince.why: 181 states and provinces keyed by StateProvinceID with code, name and pointers to CountryRegion and SalesTerritory; Address and SalesTaxRate point at it.

Store.why: One row per reseller store keyed by BusinessEntityID with name and survey data, pointing at SalesPerson; Customer points at it.

TransactionHistory.why: One row per product transaction (purchase, sale, work order), stamped with TransactionDate; ProductID repeats across rows.

UnitMeasure.why: 38 unit names keyed by UnitMeasureCode; Product, BillOfMaterials and ProductVendor point at it, so it stays unfolded.

Vendor.why: One row per vendor keyed by BusinessEntityID with account, credit rating and status; ProductVendor and PurchaseOrderHeader point at it.

WorkOrder.why: One row per manufacturing work order, stamped with StartDate, pointing at Product and ScrapReason; WorkOrderRouting points at it.

WorkOrderRouting.why: One row per operation step of a work order, stamped with scheduled and actual start dates, pointing at WorkOrder and Location.
